LDK-WHO-H2: Who the Local Domination Kit is for
LDK-WHO-BODY: Businesses that live on nearby customers. Think a dental or aesthetics clinic, a plumber covering a handful of postcodes, a hair salon, a yoga studio or a neighbourhood café. If people search for what you do and then pick whoever looks best on the map, this kit is for you.
LDK-INC-A: The Local Domination Kit covers what nearby customers see before they choose. We set up and tidy your Google Business Profile, build location pages that aren't copy-pasted and help you ask for reviews in a way that feels natural. Lead-gen ads bring in enquiries. A light brand refresh makes you look as good as you are.
LDK-INC-1-TITLE: Google Business Profile and local SEO
LDK-INC-1-BODY: Your profile set up and tidied with the right details, plus location pages that answer what local customers ask.
LDK-INC-2-BODY: A natural way to ask every customer for a review, plus ads that put you in front of nearby searchers.
LDK-INC-3-BODY: A logo tidy-up, a refined colour palette and type, a tone of voice guide and social templates. It's a refresh, not a full rebrand, and new naming isn't included.
LDK-INC-CLINIC-NOTE: Ads follow each platform's and each market's advertising rules.
LDK-MAPS-H2: How to rank higher on Google Maps
LDK-MAPS-A: Google's help page says local results are mainly based on relevance, distance and popularity. It describes the third factor as prominence: how well known a business is. In practice that means a complete, accurate Business Profile with the right categories, consistent details across the web, genuine reviews and location pages that answer what local customers ask.
LDK-REVIEWS-H2: Getting more Google reviews, the right way
LDK-REVIEWS-A: Ask every customer at a natural moment, with a direct link to your review form. Make it easy, not pushy. Never offer discounts or freebies in exchange for reviews and never ask only your happy customers, because Google's policy prohibits both. Reply to every review, including the critical ones, calmly and promptly.
LDK-VS-A: They do different jobs. Ads can put you in front of nearby searchers quickly, while local SEO and reviews build visibility that keeps working when the spend stops. The kit pairs them: lead-gen ads work on enquiries from the start while your profile, pages and reviews build up in the background.
LDK-SG-BODY: Run a café, a restaurant or an F&B brand in Singapore? Hungry people search nearby, scan the reviews and pick fast. The kit covers what they see first: a tidy Google Business Profile, local SEO pages, an honest way to ask diners for reviews, lead-gen ads and a light brand refresh, so your listing looks as good as your food.
LDK-REFRESH-H2: Why a light brand refresh is included
LDK-REFRESH-BODY: Nearby customers often compare you side by side on a map before they pick. If your profile and pages look tired next to the place down the road, good reviews have to work harder. A tidier logo, sharper colours and type, a clear tone of voice and ready-made social templates fix that without a full rebrand.
LDK-FAQ-H2: Questions about the Local Domination Kit
LDK-FAQ-1-Q: What's in the Local Domination Kit?
LDK-FAQ-1-A: Everything nearby customers see before they choose: a Google Business Profile set-up and tidy, local SEO with location pages that aren't copy-pasted, a natural way to ask for reviews, lead-gen ads and a light brand refresh. It all runs on the same brand codes, so you look like one business everywhere.
LDK-FAQ-2-Q: Do I need a Google Business Profile?
LDK-FAQ-2-A: Yes, for the kit's local work. Google Business Profiles are for businesses with a location customers can visit, or that travel to their customers, such as a clinic, a café or a mobile trade. If you don't have one yet, setting it up is part of the kit.
LDK-FAQ-3-Q: Will you get me to number one on Google Maps?
LDK-FAQ-3-A: No, and you should be wary of anyone who promises it. Nobody controls Google's local results. What we can do is make your profile complete and accurate, build pages that answer what local customers ask and help you earn genuine reviews, which are the things Google says it weighs.
LDK-FAQ-4-Q: Do you buy or fake reviews?
LDK-FAQ-4-A: Never. Fake or bought reviews break Google's policy and our own promise of no fake results. We help you ask real customers at the right moment, with a direct link and no incentives, and we never filter out the ones who might be critical. Honest reviews are the only kind worth having.
LDK-FAQ-5-Q: Do you work with restaurants and cafés in Singapore?
LDK-FAQ-5-A: Yes. Cafés, restaurants and F&B brands in Singapore get the same Local Domination Kit: a Google Business Profile set up and tidied, local SEO pages, a natural way to ask for genuine reviews, lead-gen ads and a light brand refresh.
LDK-FAQ-6-Q: What does the light brand refresh include?
LDK-FAQ-6-A: A tidy-up, not a rebrand. We clean up your logo, refine your colour palette and type, write a tone of voice guide and build social templates, so your profile, pages, posts and ads look like one business. A full rebrand and new naming aren't included. Need more? Ask on the fit call.
